def get_equal(tuples):
    """
    Returns True if all given tuples have the same length; otherwise False.
    
    Examples:
        assert get_equal([(11, 22, 33), (44, 55, 66)]) == True
        assert get_equal([(1,), (2, 3)]) == False
        assert get_equal([]) == True   # empty list is considered to have equal lengths vacuously
    """
    if not tuples:
        return True
    
    first_len = len(tuples[0])
    
    for t in tuples[1:]:
        if len(t) != first_len:
            return False
            
    return True

# Example assertions
assert get_equal([(11, 22, 33), (44, 55, 66)]) == True
assert get_equal([(1,), (2,)]) == True
assert get_equal([(1,), (2, 3)]) == False
print("All tests passed.")
